digest.component_or_area: summary compute and ticket identifier resolution
propositions: summary_compute resolves ticket state through show_state but omits the resolved alias from its return payload, causing agents to use locally salient four-character prefixes instead of human-friendly aliases
The summary schema, library, MCP, and CLI contracts institutionalize an alias-free shape that does not expose the resolved state.alias to callers
Agent guidance lacks an affirmative selection rule that directs agents to use aliases for tracker commands after discovery while reserving canonical UUIDs for identity-sensitive artifacts
Pinned behavioral evaluations with four-character prefix-only local summaries produced 25/25 four-character commands, while summaries including aliases independently produced 25/25 alias commands
The fix requires adding the exact resolved alias as an additive field to every resolvable summary result while preserving ticket_id echo contract and fail-closed behavior for ambiguous prefixes
